purpose: Desktop FP16-enabled TensorRT check for all four pruning methods and the original at fixed seed 42
performance_scope: Desktop RTX 3060 TensorRT FP16-enabled engine, batch one, fixed input size; 50 warmups and 500 synchronized model-only calls per build, one build per model; no Orin or end-to-end inference claim.
parity_scope: Compare each engine with its PyTorch checkpoint on all 445 tuning images, same preprocessing and masks, record pooled metrics, mean-image RMSE and output differences. FP16 tactic enabling does not force every layer to FP16.
limitations: Seed 42 is predetermined for all engines; accuracy selection and runtime measured on desktop, one engine build per model. Prior NYU model pretraining overlap is unknown; target-board deployment remains untested.
